name: OptoLab
lede: Turn iPhone macro images into eye-image assessments you can inspect and question.

steps.title: Capture
steps.text: An iPhone and a 15× macro lens take a close image of the front of the eye.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: Local measurements and GPT-6 Astra produce a structured image assessment.

steps.title: Question
steps.text: Each claim shows its evidence, another explanation and how to check it.

limits: Experimental hackathon prototype. Interpretations are hypotheses. Segmentation and measurements are not clinically validated.
concept: Concept. Not a medical device. Not for patient care.
